title: Late Enrollment Reinstatement Review Decisions and Months the Region Bears on TRICARE Prime
content:
On a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment brought back by an Enrollment Reinstatement Review (Appeals and Grievances), the time the review took to be decided fixes which months of the catch-up installment the region bears. **A month the region bears is not billed.**

## Rule

The days are counted in calendar days from the date the review was filed to the date it was decided, and compared with the decision deadline the Enrollment Reinstatement Review carries under Appeals and Grievances.

| Days from filing to decision | Months the region bears |
|---|---|
| more than 2 times the decision deadline | every month from the month after the filing month through the month of the decision |
| more than the decision deadline, but not more than 2 times it | the month of the decision |
| not more than the decision deadline | no month |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical decision deadline of 30 days)

| Days from filing to decision | Months the region bears |
|---|---|
| 30 | none - exactly the deadline is not after it |
| 31 | the decision month |
| 60 | the decision month - exactly twice the deadline is within twice it |
| 61 | every month from the month after the filing month through the decision month |

## Worked dates (hypothetical, deadline 30 days)

A review filed on 10 March and decided on 15 May took 66 days, more than 60: the region bears April and May. Decided on 20 April instead (41 days), the region bears April only.
